name: Joshua P.
headline: NetSuite Data Systems Manager | SuiteScript & SuiteCommerce Advanced | Solo ERP & eCommerce Architect | Expert in NetSuite Integrations & Native Customizations | 10+ Years Experience
about:
With over 20 years in web development and 10+ years of deep NetSuite experience, I’ve built and managed full-stack systems that power B2B eCommerce, internal ops, and ERP automation — often as the sole architect.

I specialize in SuiteScript (2.x), SuiteCommerce Advanced (SCA), REST integrations, and managing data flows between systems — including third-party storefronts like BigCommerce.

From item automation and shipping rate logic to customer-facing features and backend optimizations, I’ve handled everything from dirty data to production outages — and delivered results that stick.

While I haven’t worked extensively with dedicated Warehouse Management Systems, I have hands-on experience enabling, configuring, and customizing NetSuite’s native features to help improve inventory accuracy and warehouse operations.

I currently run solo as a department of one — responsible for NetSuite integrations, site maintenance, SCA customizations, and internal tech support. I've worked across 200K+ SKU inventories, rebuilt PLP/PDP UX for conversion, and implemented Map/Reduce flows to streamline data processing.

I don’t have a degree — what I do have is a proven track record of fixing, building, scaling, and shipping.

- SuiteScript (User Event, Client, Map/Reduce, RESTlet)
- SuiteCommerce Advanced (PLP, PDP, Cart customization)
- Workflow & Saved Search Automation
- Frontend dev (HTML, CSS, JS), API integration, data ops
- ERP and third-party app integrations (BigCommerce, TrustPilot)
- Enabling and customizing NetSuite native features

Now open to remote NetSuite consulting, technical manager roles, or high-impact developer opportunities where experience beats paperwork.
… more

experiences.description:
Promoted from eCommerce Website Manager to Data Systems Manager after proving ownership over NetSuite operations, integrations, and end-to-end website performance.

• Serve as the sole owner of all NetSuite development and configuration, including SCA customizations, Map/Reduce automation, RESTlets, and saved search optimization.
• Manage data flow between NetSuite and BigCommerce, maintaining product, order, and customer sync logic.
• Implemented SuiteScript solutions to automate warranty markup items, dynamic pricing logic, and upsell triggers across PLP, PDP, and Cart.
• Maintain and customize native NetSuite WMS features to improve inventory workflows.
• Oversee over 200K SKUs, 4,000+ categories, and a high-SKU B2B webstore — optimizing facets, category structure, and performance.
• Provide internal NetSuite tech support and system training, reducing downtime and dependency on third-party support.

Originally hired to manage the B2B webstore, with ownership over category structure, product listings, digital UX, and SB/SCA visual branding.

• Transitioned product catalog from static content to dynamic, data-driven structures.
• Led the redesign of PLP/PDP to improve conversion and customer experience.
• Partnered with internal teams to streamline pricing, shipping, and checkout workflows via NetSuite.
• Wrote custom HTML/CSS for hero content, promo layouts, and responsive design.
• Initiated major backend cleanup of inventory, weights, and item metadata to support accurate shipping calculations.

Designed and developed custom websites and profile layouts for small businesses, independent artists, and early social media personalities (MySpace). Delivered fully branded online experiences including layout design, graphics, and custom CSS.

Built and managed WordPress and Volusion sites, including theme customization, plugin configuration, and storefront setup. Maintained server environments using cPanel for DNS, email, and file management.

Implemented foundational SEO strategies (title/meta tags, alt attributes, keyword structure), helping clients increase visibility in early search engine indexes.

Provided full-cycle freelance services: discovery, design, build, launch, and client support — bridging technical and creative needs.
